verdict.rationale: Azure publishes a platform-wide CLI reference for managing Azure resources and a central REST API reference hub, which notes that most service REST APIs also have client libraries. A non-flagship service, Cost Management, has its own REST API reference, which shows reference coverage beyond the core services. The evidence does not show that every service has consistent API and CLI reference coverage, and the qualifier "most" suggests gaps. missing for 10: evidence of consistent per-service reference coverage across the whole catalog, CLI command-reference breadth per service, independent or hands-on corroboration of reference consistency.
